newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Nov 11 week inflation quickens to 0.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian Nov 11 week inflation quickens to 0.6 pct.

text.p: Russian inflation accelerated in the week ended November 11 to 0.6 percent from 0.3 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
Inflation in the first 11 days of November was 0.8 percent, compared with 1.2 percent in the whole of October.
If current trends were maintained, inflation for the whole of November could be 2.1 percent and 23 percent for the year.
Prices rose 1.2 percent in October and the year-on-year rate in December 1995 was 131 percent.
